scope: E-012 ReleaseManifestV1, immutable image, DEV topology, root-only preflight, release lock, compatibility, ordered deployment and rollback state evidence

T-E012-COMPOSE-001.selector: loopback TLS, DEV co-location and one-shot COS service topology cases
assertions: the DEV overlay starts only the authorized co-located PostgreSQL 18, Redis 8 and application profiles without server-side source mounts or builds
Caddy exposes API and Admin TLS only on loopback while PostgreSQL and Redis publish no host ports
the one-shot COS smoke is the only application service that receives the COS config and credential mounts and object egress network

T-E012-COS-001.selector: closed COS config, signed request and redacted diagnostic cases
assertions: the smoke client accepts only the private internal bucket endpoint, ap-shanghai region and dev/objects/ prefix
signed PUT, GET, DELETE and post-delete HEAD use one ephemeral prefixed object and always attempt cleanup
stable diagnostics disclose neither credential values, bucket identity, endpoint value nor object content

T-E012-HOST-001.selector: isolated checksum-verified host deployment runtime case
assertions: the host bootstrap installs only the exact Node 24.18.0 linux-x64 archive after matching its official SHA-256
the deployment runtime is isolated under /opt/dailyenergy/runtime and exposed as dailyenergy-node without replacing system Node or installing pnpm
unsupported OS, architecture, privilege or an inconsistent existing installation fails closed

T-E012-IMAGE-001.selector: manual main-bound GHCR image publication, CI binding and digest-only image set cases
assertions: publication is a manual development-environment workflow that accepts one exact main commit only after all eleven required checks from one successful CI run
the server is not contacted and all application roles are built on the GitHub runner, pushed to GHCR and recorded only by sha256 digest

the closed image set separately binds five expected Docker targets, commit, successful CI run and publication run and rejects missing metadata, mutable references or digest drift against ReleaseManifestV1
the minimal source-free deployment bundle binds exact Compose, controller, installer, manifest-contract and three publication-evidence files by SHA-256 and rejects path, file-set or content drift
the root-only installer atomically materializes the external COS config fingerprint and N/N-1 ReleaseManifestV1 under an owner-only versioned directory while exact replay is idempotent
BuildKit maximum provenance and attached SBOM are required while the private GitHub Free limitation remains explicit as unsigned DEV-only and production_eligible=false

T-E012-PREFLIGHT-001.selector: closed DEV host, COS config, secret-file and network preflight cases
assertions: preflight accepts only Ubuntu 24.04+ x86_64 with synchronized Asia/Shanghai time, Docker 29+, Compose 2.40+, four CPUs, seven GiB memory and twenty GiB free disk

COS config is a closed four-key document whose private internal endpoint, ap-shanghai region, dev/objects/ prefix and raw file fingerprint match the manifest without returning bucket or endpoint values

all external config and secret files remain root-owned 0600 regular single-link files under protected root-owned directories, values reach non-root containers only through service-specific Compose environment secrets mounted 0400, and revoked or split credential versions fail closed
public listeners on HTTP, TLS, PostgreSQL or Redis ports and path-capable config or secret version references fail closed

T-E012-SECRET-001.selector: versioned DEV database and fault-control secret creation cases
assertions: one fresh version creates exactly eight role-scoped random values as owner-only files and binds the PostgreSQL administrator URL to the container password
an existing complete version is revalidated without rotation while partial, extra or permission-unsafe state fails closed
the provision result reports only version, status and file count and never returns credential values

T-E012-MANIFEST-001.selector: strict ReleaseManifestV1 positive and known-fail cases
assertions: manifest accepts only the authorized DEV co-location topology, private internal COS endpoint, ap-shanghai region, dev/objects/ prefix, INFO logging and production_enabled=false
all five application and proxy image references require the expected GHCR repository role and immutable sha256 digest

unknown config, mutable tags, synthetic or wrong-region object endpoints, wrong object prefix, revoked secret versions, missing Safety/owner/deletion gates, non-synthetic evidence and production enablement fail closed
source commit, lockfile, CI run, SBOM, provenance, migration catalog and runtime fingerprints are closed required fields

T-E012-COMPAT-001.selector: mutual N/N-1 and rollback catalog compatibility cases
assertions: candidate and current release must mutually accept each other within a one-generation window
candidate catalog can advance at most one compatible generation and must explicitly name the previous release as rollback-compatible
destructive migration or an undeclared and incompatible rollback target fails closed

T-E012-LOCK-001.selector: exclusive filesystem release lock concurrency test
assertions: a second deploy cannot enter while the first release owner holds the lock
lock ownership is token-bound and released only by the holder

T-E012-STATE-001.selector: atomic release state, idempotent replay and single-use rollback target test
assertions: a successful new deployment records exactly the prior Accepted manifest as the only rollback target
replaying identical release ID and content is idempotent while content drift under one release ID is rejected
successful rollback consumes the target and prevents unrecorded ping-pong rollback

T-E012-DEPLOY-001.selector: closed DEV deployment, failure, exact replay and rollback execution cases
assertions: preflight, digest pull, co-located state readiness, ingress closure, worker drain, migration/drift proof, consumer-before-producer startup, loopback TLS and object/Safety/owner/deletion smoke execute in one closed order
a failed phase does not write Accepted state and exact replay revalidates preflight without reexecuting Docker
rollback accepts only the recorded manifest digest, reruns the complete proof sequence and consumes the single rollback target

the generated release environment contains only immutable references, fingerprints and external secret paths while root-only values are passed only to the Compose process for service-specific secrets and no credential, database URL, bucket identity or public binding is persisted

T-E012-ORDER-001.selector: closed deployment phase and receipt order test
assertions: migration and ordinary consumer workers precede the API producer
Admin and Restricted capability start only after the API producer
health plus separate object, Safety, owner and deletion smoke phases must pass before maintenance is disabled and a release can be recorded
